evidence: Introduces common::Setting in src/common/setting.h and overhauls argument and settings handling in src/common/args.cpp.
rationale: The PR replaces loose string-based argument lookups with strongly typed setting declarations across the codebase, establishing compile-time verification for setting names, types, and defaults. As noted in the description, 'nothing checks that setting names are spelled correctly, or that default values are used consistently', making this a major architectural reliability improvement for node configuration.
